# Psalm 12 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For-the-choirmaster. Upon the-eighth. A-psalm of-David.

**2** Save, YHWH, for the-faithful-one has-ceased; for the-trustworthy have-vanished from-among the-sons of-man.

**3** Emptiness they-speak, each to-his-neighbor; [with] a-lip of-smoothness, with-a-heart and-a-heart they-speak.

**4** May-YHWH cut-off all lips-of smoothness, [every] tongue speaking great-things,

**5** those-who say, 'With-our-tongue we-will-prevail; our-lips [are] with-us — who [is] lord over-us?'

**6** Because-of the-plundering of-the-poor, because-of the-groaning of-the-needy, now I-will-arise, says YHWH; I-will-set [him] in-the-safety he-longs-for.

**7** The-words of-YHWH [are] pure words, silver refined in-a-furnace of-earth, purified seven-times.

**8** You, YHWH, will-keep-them; You-will-guard us from-this generation forever.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **12:3**: 'Heart and heart' — literally a double heart. The Hebrew idiom for duplicity and insincerity.

— EMET
